subject: On the meaning of the parameters of the output of the dd_hyperbolic function

messages.author: eda08a9a0b37d0ea
messages.subject: On the meaning of the parameters of the output of the dd_hyperbolic function
parts:
Dear developers and users of hbayesDM

I would like to ask about the meaning of the output parameters of the dd_hyperbolic function.

Is it correct that the group level parameter "mu_k" is output, and the "sd" in this case simply means the sd of "mu_k"?

If so, what does the additional "sigma[1]" mean?
Also, what does the "sd" in "sigma[1]" mean in addition?


I would appreciate your answer.

messages.author: 4bcf82a01cf98f56
messages.subject: Re: On the meaning of the parameters of the output of the dd_hyperbolic function
parts:
Hi Kazuya,

Many apologies for the long delay!
Is it correct that the group level parameter "mu_k" is output, and the "sd" in this case simply means the sd of "mu_k"?

-->  There is no variable called "sd" in its stan code, but if you computed the standard deviation of the "mu_k" with 'sd' in R, that's correct. 

* If so, what does the additional "sigma[1]" mean? --> sigma is the standard deviation of the group distribution. 

* Also, what does the "sd" in "sigma[1]" mean in addition? --> Not sure what you meant by "sd" (in the summary table?) but I suspect you are referring to the standard deviation of sigma[1]?

Best,
Young
